title: KoreLumina — Master OS - Audit Roadmap Position

messages.content:
The exhaustive Master OS inventory is now valid at 41 conversations. Before authorizing capture, there is one important integrity check: some Master OS titles overlap conversations already recovered from the five earlier projects. We must determine whether they are the same conversation IDs before capture-project can overwrite any existing snapshot.
Run this overlap audit first:
Bashcd /Users/erictouko/dev/korelumina

MASTER_INVENTORY="runtime-data/genesis/chatgpt-browser-recovery/project-inventories/project-g-p-69cbc434281c8191a10f1c7b3ffe11a9.json"
SNAPSHOT_ROOT="runtime-data/genesis/chatgpt-browser-recovery/snapshots"

TMP_MASTER="$(mktemp)"
TMP_EXISTING="$(mktemp)"

jq -r \
  '.conversations[].conversationId' \
  "$MASTER_INVENTORY" \
  | sort -u \
  > "$TMP_MASTER"

for file in "$SNAPSHOT_ROOT"/conversation-*.json
do
  [ -f "$file" ] || continue

  jq -r \
    '.conversationId' \
    "$file"
done \
  | sort -u \
  > "$TMP_EXISTING"

echo "================ MASTER OS INVENTORY ================"
wc -l < "$TMP_MASTER"

echo
echo "================ ALREADY RECOVERED ================"
wc -l < "$TMP_EXISTING"

echo
echo "================ OVERLAPPING CONVERSATION IDS ================"

OVERLAP="$(
  comm -12 \
    "$TMP_MASTER" \
    "$TMP_EXISTING"
)"

if [ -z "$OVERLAP" ]; then
  echo "overlapCount=0"
else
  printf '%s\n' "$OVERLAP" \
    | tee /tmp/korelumina-master-os-overlap.txt

  echo
  echo "overlapCount=$(
    printf '%s\n' "$OVERLAP" \
      | sed '/^$/d' \
      | wc -l \
      | tr -d ' '
  )"
fi

echo
echo "================ OVERLAP PROVENANCE ================"

if [ -n "$OVERLAP" ]; then
  while IFS= read -r id
  do
    [ -n "$id" ] || continue

    existing="$SNAPSHOT_ROOT/conversation-$id.json"

    echo
    echo "conversationId=$id"

    jq -n \
      --argjson master "$(
        jq \
          --arg id "$id" \
          '.conversations[] | select(.conversationId == $id)' \
          "$MASTER_INVENTORY"
      )" \
      --argjson existing "$(
        jq \
          '{
            conversationId,
            projectId,
            title,
            conversationUrl,
            capturedAt,
            messageCount: (.messages | length)
          }' \
          "$existing"
      )" \
      '{
        masterOS: $master,
        existingSnapshot: $existing
      }'
  done <<< "$OVERLAP"
fi

rm -f \
  "$TMP_MASTER" \
  "$TMP_EXISTING"
We need to know which state we have:
A. overlapCount = 0
   → Master OS can be authorized and captured normally.

B. overlapCount > 0, same conversation IDs
   → do NOT capture yet.
      Those chats have apparently been moved/reorganized between
      ChatGPT projects, and our current snapshot filename scheme
      would overwrite existing project provenance.
This matters because our current storage key is:
conversation-<conversationId>.json
not:
<projectId>/conversation-<conversationId>.json
So if the same conversation appears in Master OS and an earlier project, blindly capturing all 41 could silently replace the earlier projectId and source URL.
Do not mark Master OS RECOVER yet. The overlap result determines whether we can capture immediately or first need a small provenance-preservation hardening milestone.

The overlap audit is clean:
Master OS inventory      41
Already recovered        15
Overlapping IDs           0
That means Master OS can be enrolled and captured without overwriting any existing recovered conversation.
Authorize it:
Bashcd /Users/erictouko/dev/korelumina

node scripts/genesis-chatgpt-browser-recovery.mjs \
  set-project \
  g-p-69cbc434281c8191a10f1c7b3ffe11a9 \
  RECOVER \
  "KoreLumina Master OS historical project"
Then capture all 41 conversations from the exhaustive inventory:
Bashnode scripts/genesis-chatgpt-browser-recovery.mjs \
  capture-project \
  runtime-data/genesis/chatgpt-browser-recovery/project-inventories/project-g-p-69cbc434281c8191a10f1c7b3ffe11a9.json
This will take noticeably longer than the earlier projects because it has 41 conversations. The checkpoint should update after every successful capture, so interruption is safe.
When it completes, validate the Master OS checkpoint:
Bashjq '{
  projectId,
  projectTitle,
  completed: (.completedConversationIds | length),
  completedConversationIds,
  failureCount: (.failures | length),
  failures
}' \
runtime-data/genesis/chatgpt-browser-recovery/checkpoints/project-g-p-69cbc434281c8191a10f1c7b3ffe11a9.json
Target:
projectTitle = KoreLumina — Master OS
completed    = 41
failureCount = 0
Then inspect the aggregate recovery totals:
Bashjq -s '
  {
    projects: (
      map(.projectId)
      | unique
      | length
    ),

    conversations: length,

    messages: (
      map(.messages | length)
      | add
    ),

    byProject: (
      group_by(.projectId)
      | map({
          projectId: .[0].projectId,
          conversations: length,
          messages: (
            map(.messages | length)
            | add
          )
        })
    )
  }
' \
runtime-data/genesis/chatgpt-browser-recovery/snapshots/conversation-*.json
Expected conversation total after Master OS succeeds:
previous recovered = 15
Master OS           = 41
                    ----
total               = 56 conversations
Do not commit yet. Once Master OS is 41/41 with zero failures, the next step is production-adapter validation of all 56 recovered conversations before we feed browser recovery into the actual Genesis acquisition/reconciliation pipeline.
